newsitem.title: CANADA: William Resources sells Brazil Sabara stake.
newsitem.headline: William Resources sells Brazil Sabara stake.

text.p: William Resources Inc said on Wednesday it agreed to sell its 50 percent stake in the Sabara gold project in Brazil to its joint venture partner Brazilian Resources Inc for about US$9 million.

William said it would receive US$2 million in cash in scheduled payments over 24 months, and two million shares of Brazilian Resources. William would get more cash payments of up to US$6.25 million, depending on exploration progress at the property.
A portion of the US$6.25 million payment might revert to a two percent net smelter royalty if certain production targets were not achieved, William said.

William president Stan Bharti said the sale of the stake was consistent with William's strategy to focus on production and exploration at its core operations and become an intermediate gold producer in 1997.
"The cash from Sabara will be used to expand and explore our other mines and for the recently announced acquisition of Terra Mining AB," Bharti said.
